suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add numeric field convention: all count/duration numeric fields in Zod schemas should use .int().nonnegative() rather than plain z.number(). This is the pattern followed by the integrate schemas and should be applied consistently across all steps.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: integrate-schema uses .int().nonnegative() consistently on all numeric fields, while execute/schema.ts uses plain z.number() for total/queued/running/completed/failed/blocked counts in ExecuteArtifactSummarySchema.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Note that two schemas in execute/schema.ts (ExecuteArtifactSummarySchema and StateTransitionSchema) are missing .strict() contrary to the documented convention. This should be fixed in a future cleanup task.
